planItem: 77.44.7.A — responsive size width/height constraints Inspector lifecycle across all editable PARTIAL types
finding: The registry defines six responsive dimension fields, but the cross-type lifecycle previously covered aspectRatio across all 44 editable PARTIAL types while the width/height/min/max fields had primarily representative lifecycle evidence. The shared Inspector re-renders after responsive.set, so the size accordion must be reopened before each field interaction.
change: Added tests/browser/editor-inspector-size-partial-types.test.js as a dedicated real-Chromium matrix. It sets six size fields through the Inspector across all 44 editable PARTIAL node types; checks responsive command/key routes, Canvas computed CSS, draft Page Model values, Save/public separation, Editor reload and explicit Publish for desktop/mobile; resets every mobile field, verifies Undo/Redo, reset Save/public immutability and separate Publish restoring inherited desktop CSS.
testStructure: Kept the already passing 14-typography/effect/aspect-ratio browser matrix unchanged and moved the new dimension coverage into its own focused test file to keep failures and execution time isolated.

reuseReview.solution: Reused the existing Inspector Property Registry, responsive.set command, typed dimension controls, reset/undo system, local Chromium fixture pattern, and native CSS sizing.
reuseReview.thirdPartyCodeOrDependency: None; no external package is needed or appropriate for native CSS dimensions.

browser.coverage: Each field reaches Canvas CSS and persisted Page Model for desktop and mobile. Draft Save does not change the published snapshot; Editor reload retains values; separate Publish applies each viewport; desktop values survive mobile Publish; each mobile field resets to desktop inheritance; Undo/Redo, reset Save and the final reset Publish are checked.
